method_limits: member identity is the filesystem mtime of each .json face directly under the named directory; a checkout that rewrote every file would restamp the whole family and read every base as frozen, so this face is a reading of the working tree, not of git history
subdirectories are not descended: E435's base is the directory that holds the face, and a family two levels down is not 'directly under it'
the carrier is excluded from its own member list, otherwise a face that names its own directory is always its own newest member and every such base reads frozen
this study's own faces (facehome_latest.json and FACEHOME-*.json) are excluded from the member scan, otherwise results/state_tilt reads live because of the reader itself
mtime equality is graded frozen: a member written in the same second as the carrier cannot be shown to postdate it
a live base proves the family is growing, not that any join will ever be written; the composable cross-tab is the population a landing target would change, not a claim that one will appear

distance_check.reading: the same population re-read from the live tree; the member counts are the new axis and cannot agree with E435 because E435 never counted them

title: map each of E435's face-home directory values to the family of published faces living directly under it, publish the per-family member count and the newest member, and flag the families whose newest member postdates the face that names the value
